correctness.rationale: The four-case interface equation follows from the exact local rule; an injective charging of new defects to old defects proves nonincrease, and equality forces propagation without collision. Finite-ring relative motion excludes mixed velocities in a recurrent orbit. Pure-wave and frozen sectors yield exact closure and t-step phase congruences. Binomial counting, roots-of-unity filtering and Möbius inversion then prove all asserted formulas. Exhaustive standalone computations validate all states for n=3..10 and local interfaces through n=8; they supplement, not replace, the all-length proof.

value.rationale: A complete quantitative temporal fixed-point and orbit census on every finite ring is a natural dynamical invariant for the canonical four-color cyclic-contact CA. The new closure-congruence conditions distinguish which traveling front configurations truly return, and exclude all temporal periods other than one or sufficiently large circumference divisors. The all-parameter formula and recurrent-state entropy turn qualitative particle dynamics into a precise observable, without arbitrary parameter slices.
